description: A script for cleaning up download directories in OpenWrt, deleting older versions of program tarballs while keeping the latest.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a file entry in the download directory, capable of parsing version info and deleting files/directories.

methods.name: parseVer_123
methods.description: Parses version string matching pattern 1.2.3 with optional patch level.

methods.name: parseVer_12
methods.description: Parses version string matching pattern 1.2 with optional patch.

methods.name: parseVer_r
methods.description: Parses version string matching pattern r1111.

methods.name: parseVer_ymd_GIT_SHASUM
methods.description: Parses version string with date and GIT SHASUM.

methods.name: parseVer_GIT
methods.description: Uses file modification time as version.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling argument parsing, directory scanning, and cleanup logic.
